description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5330014671978 SEAL,PLAIN: Line 0001 Qty 3122 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0175 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 468. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 0HRD8 E15-0224-10; 0HRD8 HS5757-200-A; 15284 0945; 8V613 HS5757-200-A. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
